automation.description: Local Lua recipes and typed nodes for Ledger. XML owns IDs, ports, parameters, tags, aliases and descriptions; generated catalog.lua is consumed by the Lua runtime. CSV means UTF-8 CSV, not XLSX. A preview never writes; apply is explicit. Match normalization trims whitespace and folds ASCII and Russian Cyrillic case; it is not full Unicode normalization. Missing match keys are rejected. Counterparty matching requires INN; an explicitly empty KPP is allowed for entrepreneurs.

node.description: Use rows supplied as Lua tables.

function.name: search
function.description: Search documented recipe/node titles, aliases and tags. Query terms use AND matching, tags use exact AND matching; kind is recipe or node. Returns catalog metadata.

function.name: preview
function.description: Run a recipe without writes. Import/replacement recipes return a change plan; checks and reports return result arrays.
function.param: Recipe ID from this XML catalog.

function.name: execute
function.description: Validate a typed acyclic node graph, then evaluate its output. Graph nodes have id/type/input/params; graph.output names the result node. No apply node exists: graph evaluation never commits data.
function.param: Graph data with nodes and output.

function.name: apply
function.description: Apply a prepared change plan atomically. Refuses plan errors, stale snapshots, changed match keys and duplicate targets. Requires a writable host run. Catalog API enforces types and references even for hand-written plans.
function.param: Plan returned by preview or a plan node.

function.name: register
function.description: Register an XML-generated plugin descriptor and its Lua implementations. Standard and custom plugins use the same registry; duplicate plugin, node or recipe IDs are rejected before registration.
function.param: Generated metadata or Lua implementation table.
Generated metadata or Lua implementation table.
Generated metadata or Lua implementation table.
